sentences.text: This Pacific bluefin tuna carried its tag for {days_tracked}, from {first_date} to {last_date}: {species_rank_days}.
Pacific bluefin tuna spawn in the western Pacific, and some young fish cross the ocean to feed off North America before returning west.
On {farthest_date} it was {max_displacement_km} from where its track began.
What the tuna did after its tag stopped reporting isn't known.
